subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` header make `/v1/chat/completions` ignore arbitrary OpenAI SDK request-body `model` values and run the selected agent's configured model?
rationale: Current source, tests, and docs intentionally define the request `model` as an OpenClaw agent target and use `x-openclaw-model` for backend overrides, so the requested behavior changes a public Gateway API precedence rule.

options.title: Approve narrow header precedence
options.body: Allow generic body model values to be ignored only after `x-openclaw-agent-id` resolves to a known agent, with docs and tests preserving strict validation when no valid header is present.

options.title: Keep current agent-target contract
options.body: Continue requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>` and direct clients to `x-openclaw-model` for backend model overrides.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow header precedence
recommendation.body: Allow generic body model values to be ignored only after `x-openclaw-agent-id` resolves to a known agent, with docs and tests preserving strict validation when no valid header is present.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current agent-first Gateway contract and recently merged adjacent selector handling on this surface.
